hints.title: Index Placement Pigeonhole Principle
hints.text: For an array of length n, the first missing positive integer must fall in the integer range one through n plus one.

hints.title: Cyclic Value-to-Index Swapping
hints.text: Place each integer x in the range one through n at target index x minus one by repeatedly swapping until each element is correctly positioned or invalid.

hints.title: Linear Discrepancy Scanning
hints.text: After placing all eligible elements, scan from index zero to n minus one. The first index i where nums[i] does not equal i plus one reveals the answer i plus one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting takes O(N log N) time and auxiliary hash sets violate the strict O(1) auxiliary space requirement.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Cyclic placement puts each number in its bucket in at most one swap per element, achieving linear time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate must implement the while swap condition carefully to prevent infinite loops when duplicates are present.
